description: Unofficial fan art of Uzi Doorman from Murder Drones. Early worker-drone companion with a striped pompom beanie, purple screen eyes, circuit-board checks, a headphone-clip greeting, safe-latch inspection, compact jumps and articulated three-direction mechanical running. Opaque dark lower-body layers and unpowered limited-travel props are safe original adaptations. No tail, wings, weapons or Solver form; no affiliation or endorsement.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
